freeze: false
format:
  typst:
    output-file: cv.pdf
    template-partials:
      - typst-template.typ

```{r cv-typst}
#| results: asis
#| message: false
#| warning: false

source(here::here("cv", "render.R"))

# AI / scientific software variant. Keeps the cv.pdf filename so existing links
# (LinkedIn, mail signature, UIs that deep-link the CV) keep resolving.
profile <- load_profile("ai")

cat("```{=typst}\n")
cat(render_cv_typst(profile))
cat("\n```\n")
```
